title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.43 (versions follow prime numbers), everything inside: the code, Luma and Razar are the same as v0.41 (freedom: Luma chooses to rest, to think or to give, by her own counts); this version exists so that the archived copy carries the whole work of 2026-11-19, including the DOIs of v0.37 and v0.41, which were written one commit after their own archives. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.43: todo adentro — la copia archivada lleva completo el trabajo del 2026-11-19. Prototipo de investigación.
